english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something genuinely pure, unadulterated, or unsullied.
This is the all-purpose choice for something pure and not mixed with anything else.
This is the all-purpose choice for a substance that is pure or unadulterated, such as wine.
Use this for a substance that is pure and unmixed, especially in everyday descriptions.
